formName: Step 7 - Applicant Information - My Profile - Water Licence Application
formDescription: This profile page lets the applicant review and update their own legal name, contact information, default relationship to applicant, and mailing address. The mailing address is shown in a grid/table and can be opened with the Go to Address action. The user can also return to My Applications, cancel, or save changes.

MiddleName.title: Middle Name:
MiddleName.description: The applicant's legal middle name, if applicable.

DaytimePhoneNumber.title: Day Time Phone:
DaytimePhoneNumber.description: The applicant's daytime phone number, if different from the primary phone number.

DaytimePhoneNumberExtension.title: Ext.
DaytimePhoneNumberExtension.description: Optional extension for the applicant's daytime phone number.

FaxNumber.title: Fax:
FaxNumber.description: Optional fax number for the applicant.

Link_1_198463491.title: Go to Address
Link_1_198463491.description: Action link that opens the selected mailing address record for review or update.

ReturnToMyApplications_Link.title: Return to My Applications
ReturnToMyApplications_Link.description: Returns the user to the My Applications page.

OnBehalfOfTypeId_100060813_198463485.title: Default Relationship to Applicant:
OnBehalfOfTypeId_100060813_198463485.description: Dropdown/select input for the applicant's default relationship to the applicant. This control has no data-id in the HTML, so the element id is used.
enum: Executor, Administrator, Trust (Letter Required: Copy of Will, Letter of Appointment)
Power of Attorney (Letter Required: Power of Attorney)

cphBottomFunctionBand_ctl06_Submit.title: Save
cphBottomFunctionBand_ctl06_Submit.description: Saves profile changes entered directly by the user.
